Question: 尼克松在回顾1972年访华时说：“我知道，1954年在……时福斯特·杜勒斯（当时的美国国务卿）拒绝同周（周恩来）握手，使他身受侮辱。因此我走完梯级时决心伸出我的手，一边向他走去。当我们的手相握的时候，一个时代结束了，另一个时代开始了。”对上述材料理解正确的是
A: 尼克松与周恩来握手意味着美国彻底放弃了遏制中国政策
B: 尼克松否定了福斯特·杜勒斯的对华态度
C: 中美关系对20世纪70年代的国际关系有重要影响
D: 省略部分应是万隆会议
options:
A. 尼克松与周恩来握手意味着美国彻底放弃了遏制中国政策
B. 尼克松否定了福斯特·杜勒斯的对华态度
C. 中美关系对20世纪70年代的国际关系有重要影响
D. 省略部分应是万隆会议

C. 中美关系对20世纪70年代的国际关系有重要影响
D. 省略部分应是万隆会议
en:
The next question is about China's foreign policy.
When Nixon reviewed his visit to China in 1972, he said: "I knew that in 1954, Foster Dulles (then US Secretary of State) refused to shake hands with Zhou (Zhou Enlai), which insulted him. So I decided to extend my hand as I walked towards him as I walked down the steps. When our hands shook, one era ended and another began." The correct understanding of the above material is 
A. Nixon's handshake with Zhou Enlai meant that the United States completely abandoned the policy of containing China 
B. Nixon denied Foster Dulles' attitude towards China 
C. Sino-US relations had an important impact on international relations in the 1970s 
D. The omitted part should be the Bandung Conference

en:
The next question is about China's foreign policy.
Premier Zhou Enlai stressed that in order to resist the aggression and threat of the United States, it was necessary to ally with the Soviet Union, but "the independence of our party and country must not be lost"; at the "Bandung Conference", Zhou Enlai clearly put forward the policy of "seeking common ground while reserving differences" for the contradictions and differences between countries due to different social systems and ideologies, saying that "the Chinese delegation came to seek unity rather than quarrel." This shows that
A. An independent and peaceful foreign policy is the fundamental guarantee of the diplomacy of New China
B. "Seeking common ground while reserving differences" is the basic principle of my country's handling of relations with Asian and African countries
C. Alliance with the Soviet Union is the fundamental guarantee for resisting the aggression and threat of the United States against China
D. During the Sino-Soviet alliance period, my country's foreign policy was highly consistent with that of the Soviet Union

A. China facilitated the meeting of the heads of the five permanent members of the Security Council
B. China first proposed the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence

Question: 20世纪60年代中期的民意测验显示，大多数美国人对中国的印象是“无知”、“好战”、“狡诈”、“危险”；到了70年代初期，这种印象变为“勤劳”、“智慧”、“灵巧”、“善于进取”、“讲求实际”。导致这两种印象的原因分别是

The next question is about China's foreign policy.

By the early 1970s, this impression had changed to "hard-working," "intelligent," "clever," "aggressive," and "pragmatic." The reasons for these two impressions are:
A. New China implemented a "one-sided" foreign policy; China and the United States formally established diplomatic relations in 1979
B. At the beginning of the founding of New China, the United States adopted a hostile policy toward China; U.S. President Nixon visited China in 1972

D. The impact of the US-Soviet Cold War; the United Nations restored the legitimate seat of the People's Republic of China in 1971

Question: 20世纪70年代中国迎来了第三次建交高潮，1971年与中国建交的国家有l5个，l972年达到了18个，加拿大、意大利、奥地利、比利时、日本、联邦德国、澳大利亚、英国等西方资本主义国家先后与中国建立了外交关系。这一建交热潮的出现，为中国走近世界和世界走进中国提供了前提。其主要说明

Western capitalist countries such as Canada, Italy, Austria, Belgium, Japan, Federal Germany, Australia, and the United Kingdom successively established diplomatic relations with China. The emergence of this wave of diplomatic relations provided a premise for China to approach the world and the world to approach China. Its main explanations
A. Sino-Japanese and Sino-US relations gradually normalized
B. The emergence of the third wave of diplomatic relations is conducive to world peace
C. The third wave of diplomatic relations provided an important premise for reform and opening up
D. The third wave of diplomatic relations improved China's international status

Question: 抗美援朝，是抗美援朝战争和抗美援朝运动的统称（多指抗美援朝战争），是20世纪50年代初，中国人民支援朝鲜人民抗击美国侵略的群众性运动。1950年10月，中国人民志愿军赴朝作战，抗美援朝开始。在抗美援朝战争中，志愿军得到了解放军全军和中国全国人民的全力支持，得到了以苏联为首的社会主义阵营的配合。1953年7月，双方签订《朝鲜停战协定》，抗美援朝胜利结束。这一历史事件从国际角度体现了
A: 为完全解决朝鲜问题奠定了条件
B: 维护新中国利益，标志着新中国外交的成熟
C: 遏制美国“扶蒋反共”政策
D: “一边倒”，反击美国在亚洲的“包围圈”
options:
A. 为完全解决朝鲜问题奠定了条件
B. 维护新中国利益，标志着新中国外交的成熟
C. 遏制美国“扶蒋反共”政策
D. “一边倒”，反击美国在亚洲的“包围圈”

en:
The next question is about China's foreign policy.
The War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea is a general term for the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea and the Movement to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea (mostly referring to the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea). It was a mass movement in the early 1950s in which the Chinese people supported the Korean people in resisting U.S. aggression. In October 1950, the Chinese People's Volunteer Army went to Korea to fight, and the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea began. In the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea, the Volunteer Army received full support from the entire People's Liberation Army and the Chinese people, and received cooperation from the socialist camp headed by the Soviet Union. In July 1953, the two sides signed the "Korean Armistice Agreement", and the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea ended in victory. This historical event reflects from an international perspective
A. It laid the foundation for the complete resolution of the Korean issue
B. It safeguarded the interests of New China and marked the maturity of New China's diplomacy
C. It curbed the U.S. policy of "supporting Chiang Kai-shek and opposing the Communist Party"
D. It "leaned to one side" and fought back against the U.S. "encirclement" in Asia

Question: “当我走到扶梯最后一节，迈步向他（周恩来）走去时，特意伸出手去……”（《尼克松回忆录》）。美国总统尼克松“伸手”的原因是
A: 主张建立和平相处的国际关系
B: 歌颂中华民族的伟大
C: 认识到美国与中国发展关系的必要性

A. It is conducive to China's return to the United Nations

C: 强调意识形态的差异

This statement reflects the U.S. foreign policy
A. The United States is willing to improve relations with China

The next question is about China's foreign policy.

In the designer's view
A. China and the United States can establish good neighborly and friendly relations
B. Nixon and Mao and Zhou became political friends
C. Nixon's visit to China has epoch-making significance
D. China and the United States finally broke the ice and realized the long-cherished wish of establishing diplomatic relations

The development of Sino-Soviet relations at that time
A. Helped consolidate the new people's regime
B. Breaking through the ideological restrictions on my country's diplomacy
C. Reflected the relationship between countries that form partnerships and non-alignment
D. Implemented the policy of "cleaning up the house before inviting guests"

Mao Zedong once emphasized: "China must join the United Nations. We also added that if the United Nations does not represent China with 600 million people, then the United Nations will become a place for farce... There can only be one China in the United Nations, not 'two Chinas', and that China is us." The following understanding of this is incorrect
A. Only the People's Republic of China can represent China in joining the United Nations
B. The United Nations needs to respect China's national unity
C. The United Nations without China is illegal
D. "Taiwan" has no right to represent the Chinese people in the United Nations

A. supporting China's restoration of its legitimate seat in the United Nations

options:

B. 积极团结发展中国家

B. actively united developing countries

A: bcd

Because of this, I have taken the initiative in several aspects to open the door to more normal relations between the two countries." The change in Nixon's attitude before and after shows: a-The United States was right to adopt a policy of containment and isolation against China in the early post-war period; b The United States should take the initiative to promote the normalization of relations between the two countries; c The United States always takes its own interests as the starting point for dealing with international relations; d China is playing an increasingly important role in international affairs

B. abc
C. abcd
D. abd

B. When China and the Soviet Union ally, we should give up the resistance to Soviet great power chauvinism, because China wants to unite with the Soviet Union
C. An independent and peaceful foreign policy is the fundamental policy of New China's diplomacy

In July 1971, President Nixon gave a speech in Kansas City, pointing out: "When I delivered my inaugural address, I mentioned a time of negotiation... We are negotiating rather than confronting in many parts of the world..." The US government put this diplomatic thought into practice, including the following actions: a. The United States and the Soviet Union reached the "Camp David Spirit"; b. Ended the Vietnam War that began in 1961; c. Signed the "North Atlantic Treaty"; d. Issued the "Shanghai Communiqué" between China and the United States
A. bcd
B. ac
C. abd
D. bd
